text: I love the product but I genuinely can't figure out the pricing tiers. Spent 20 minutes on the pricing page still confused which plan I need.
Why is there no CSV export? I need this data in Excel for my manager every week and I'm stuck copy-pasting rows manually.
The dashboard takes forever to load, especially in the mornings. Sometimes I just give up and check back later.
First week was rough — nobody explained what to do after signup. Just dropped into an empty dashboard with no guidance.
Your support team resolved my billing issue in literally 10 minutes over chat. Genuinely impressed, wanted to say thanks.
Confusing pricing page. I upgraded thinking I'd get feature X and didn't — had to email support to understand the difference between plans.
Mobile app crashes every time I try to attach a photo to a report. Happens on both wifi and mobile data.
Please add export to Excel or Google Sheets. Being locked into your UI for reporting is a dealbreaker for my team.
Loading is painfully slow when I have more than a few hundred rows. Feels like it's not built for real data volume.
Onboarding just throws you in with zero tooltips. A short walkthrough would've saved me an hour of clicking around confused.
Whoever handled my refund request was fantastic — fast, clear, no hassle at all.
I still don't understand what's different between the Pro and Business plans. The comparison table doesn't help much.
Export feature would change everything for me. Right now I screenshot tables which is embarrassing honestly.
App froze and crashed twice today on Android while uploading images.
Dashboard load time got noticeably worse over the last month. Used to be fast, now it's a coffee-break wait.
New user here — wish there was a guided setup instead of a blank screen. Almost gave up on day one.
Billing was unclear so I contacted support, and honestly the rep was excellent and patient with me.
Would pay more for a real export function. CSV, Excel, anything — just get my data out of here easily.
Crashes when attaching files on mobile, very frustrating during client visits.
Pricing page doesn't clarify what happens if I go over my usage limit. Found out the hard way with a surprise charge.
Big pages load slowly, especially on my laptop which isn't old. Might be a backend issue on your end.
No onboarding checklist or tour at all. Felt lost for the first few days using this.
Just wanted to flag — your live chat support has been consistently great every time I've used it.
I need to export reports weekly and currently rely on a third-party workaround because you don't support it natively.
